sonnet.problem: The statement opens with "By the end of all this," which adds a time and sequence that verse 15 doesn't give. It also reshapes "head or tail" into "from the head to the tail."
sonnet.rule: Times stay true. No time in the text means none added.

sonnet.problem: The true/false statement tests several claims at once: the LORD strikes Egypt with a plague, Egypt turns to Him, He hears their prayers, and He heals them.
sonnet.rule: A true or false statement tests one claim.
